fields.title: Facebook Ad Library record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one ad per row. One AD row per ad, one RUN_SUMMARY row per run, ERROR rows when a search fails. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search this record came from, as 'keyword:<term> @ <country>' or 'page:<id> @ <country>'.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed or unexpected_error.

adArchiveId.title: Ad archive ID
adArchiveId.description: Meta's permanent identifier for the ad.

adLibraryUrl.title: Ad Library URL
adLibraryUrl.description: Direct link to this ad's page in the public Ad Library.

isActive.title: Currently running
isActive.description: Whether Meta reports the ad as still being delivered.

pageId.title: Advertiser page ID
pageId.description: Numeric id of the Facebook page paying for the ad. This is the id the 'advertisers' input accepts.

pageName.title: Advertiser
pageName.description: Display name of the advertising page.

pageUrl.title: Advertiser page URL
pageUrl.description: Profile URI of the advertising page.

pageCategories.title: Advertiser categories
pageCategories.description: Categories the advertiser page lists for itself.

pageLikeCount.title: Advertiser likes
pageLikeCount.description: Like count of the advertising page at the time of the fetch.

startDate.title: First shown
startDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC date the ad began running.

endDate.title: Last shown
endDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of the ad's flight. For an ad still running this is the current end, not a stop date -- read it together with isActive.

runningDays.title: Days on air
runningDays.description: Whole days between startDate and endDate. Null when either date is missing.

adText.title: Ad copy
adText.description: The ad's primary body text. Dynamic-creative ads legitimately contain Meta template tokens such as {{product.name}}; that is the real published text.

linkUrl.title: Destination URL
linkUrl.description: Where the ad sends the click.

ctaText.title: CTA label
ctaText.description: Text on the call-to-action button, e.g. 'Shop now'.

ctaType.title: CTA type
ctaType.description: Meta's internal CTA code, e.g. LEARN_MORE.

displayFormat.title: Creative format
displayFormat.description: VIDEO, IMAGE, DCO, CAROUSEL and similar.

publisherPlatforms.title: Platforms
publisherPlatforms.description: Meta surfaces the ad is delivered on.

imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Every image creative, including carousel cards.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: Direct HD and SD video files. These are signed CDN URLs and expire.

thumbnailUrls.title: Video thumbnails
thumbnailUrls.description: Preview frames for the video creatives.

cards.title: Carousel cards
cards.description: Per-card headline, body, caption, CTA and link for carousel ads.

imageCount.title: Images
imageCount.description: How many image creatives the ad carries.

videoCount.title: Videos
videoCount.description: How many video creatives the ad carries.

adTextWordCount.title: Copy length (words)
adTextWordCount.description: Word count of the ad body, for comparing copy length across a niche.

collationCount.title: Grouped variants
collationCount.description: How many near-identical ads Meta collapsed into this entry.

impressionsText.title: Impressions range
impressionsText.description: Published only for political and issue ads. Empty for commercial ads by Meta policy.

spendText.title: Spend range
spendText.description: Published only for political and issue ads. Empty for commercial ads by Meta policy.

targetedCountries.title: Targeted countries
targetedCountries.description: Published only for political and issue ads.

byline.title: Byline
byline.description: 'Paid for by' text, on ads that carry a disclaimer.

searchCountry.title: Search country
searchCountry.description: The Ad Library country this row was found in.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: The keyword this row was found with, if the search was keyword-based.

searchUrl.title: Search URL
searchUrl.description: The Ad Library URL this row came from -- open it to see the same result set in a browser.

totalMatchingAds.title: Total matching ads
totalMatchingAds.description: How many ads Facebook says match the search, which is usually far more than the run collected.

isBrandedContent.title: Branded content
isBrandedContent.description: True when a creator's page posted the ad and a brand paid for it. On an advertiser-scoped search these rows carry the creator in pageName and the paying brand in sponsorPageName.

sponsorPageName.title: Paying brand
sponsorPageName.description: The brand behind a branded-content ad. Null for ordinary ads.

sponsorPageId.title: Paying brand page ID
sponsorPageId.description: Numeric page id of the paying brand on branded-content ads.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per ad: who is running it, what it says and how long it has been up.

creative.title: Creative
creative.description: The copy and media of each ad, for a swipe file.

advertisers.title: Advertisers
advertisers.description: Who is advertising, and on which surfaces.

transparency.title: Spend and impressions
transparency.description: The fields Meta publishes for political and issue ads only.
